title: 九成投入只保旧供：新增产能仅一成，储气开发没人加码
speaker: Mel Eidros

segments.en: Given the volatility that we have seen, are you seeing more interest, more capital coming through into investments, into things like storage, into transportation, regassification, and
segments.zh: 鉴于我们看到的波动性，你是否看到更多兴趣、更多资本进入**，进入储存、运输、再气化等领域？

segments.en: the like? That's something that we, at the International Gas Unit, have pointed out for a few years now, that the investments are not sufficient enough to meet the future demands.
segments.zh: 这是我们国际燃气联盟多年来一直指出的问题：**不足以满足未来需求。

segments.en: 90% of the investments are going into simply keeping up with the existing deliverability of
segments.zh: 90%的**仅仅用于维持现有资源的交付能力。

segments.en: the resource. Only 10% of the current investments go towards growth, and that's on the upstream side.
segments.zh: 目前只有10%的**用于增长，而且是在上游领域。

segments.en: We haven't seen significant investments in storage development, and I think that's something that we will be looking for now moving into the future in view of how important it is from
segments.zh: 我们尚未看到储存开发方面的重大**，我认为鉴于供应安全的重要性，这将是未来我们关注的重点。
从供应安全的角度来看。
